title: Structured result of the execution-test-designer agent
description: Self-contained (inlined as the agent() schema). The test-designer is never the implementer: it writes each task's proof and acceptance checks (failing first) and records the negative control it ran. Proof objects it returns are applied to the plan only through `exec.py amend` (after approval) or `plan instantiate` (before), never by editing plan.json. Recorded with `exec.py result put --role test-designer`.

commit.description: The `exec.py snapshot` commit holding the acceptance checks (a commit object on origin/main at refs/exec/<task>/td-a<n>r<k>; the test-designer never commits in the shared checkout); null when only proof objects were produced.

file_blobs.description: Path -> git blob id of each file in the snapshot, as `snapshot` printed it: the tamper reference of fix tests (FIX-MODE.md 6.3).

message_file.description: The conventional commit message file the integrator's merge --single-tree uses.

proof.description: A full plan proof object (plan.schema.json#/$defs/proof); validated by exec.py when applied.

gates_config.description: Contract wave only: a /harden gates.py config (offline install, typecheck, lint, test) the test-designer wrote in its inbox; the orchestrator installs it as .execution/gates.json through `exec.py amend` (patch gates_json).
